scenario: `ttl:` is optional on `cache` per LSTO.9.6 — without it, the key is durable until `cache_delete` (subject to runtime-policy eviction). Pins that omitting `ttl:` is legal at compile time, mirror to LCRS.5.2 which pins required key + value.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    cache key: "k" value: t.v
